name: @ppe/mrz
description: Reading identity documents' machine-readable zone (ICAO Doc 9303): TD1, TD2 and TD3 parsing, check digits, the look-alike corrections that check digits confirm, date centuries, the Lithuanian personal code and the folding of printed names to their MRZ form. Pure TypeScript, no DOM; the Go API's parser reads the same test vectors (testdata/mrz).
